description: This is a FastAPI backend source file implementing a data product publishing workflow API. It includes route handlers for submitting drafts, running validations, creating approvals, and publishing drafts, along with custom exception handling and middleware setup. The file references internal modules for models, repositories, security, and services, and defines endpoints documenting various API behaviors and error responses.
